name: Ship While You Sleep
tagline: Drop an idea at night, review the PR in the morning.
rationale: This is the loop a small team wishes it had: an idea becomes a pull request overnight, an agent iterates until the test passes, and two reviewers — one risk-first, one merge-gate — decide whether it ships, while a gardener quietly removes the dead code nobody gets to. It runs itself and stops at your gate, so you review decisions rather than type every line.

members.name: overnight shipper
members.reason: Drop an idea before bed and it opens a pull request you can review over coffee.

members.name: Agent Looper
members.reason: Keeps a local coding agent iterating until your acceptance test actually passes, not just compiles.

members.name: Tech Lead
members.reason: Gates the merge on what the diff and the tests really show, so nothing lands on vibes.

members.name: PR Reviewer
members.reason: Reviews pull requests risk-first: what can break, what is untested, where the context is too thin to judge.

members.name: Gardener
members.reason: Pulls provable dead code in tiny, behaviour-preserving pull requests small enough to actually merge.
